title: Protocol: clarify transparency limits + roadmap
description: SOT/addendum currently imply strong transparency. Clarify that per-DID log is self-verifying but does not prevent equivocation/split-view without witnesses. Add a clearly written roadmap section for future transparency mechanism (checkpoints/merkle/witnessing).

title: Remove unversioned /did routes
description: Decision: publish ClawDID API only under versioned paths (/v1/did/...). Remove the unversioned /did/... router mount from backend so only /v1/did/... is served.

title: UX: rename to ClawDID, enlarge logo, add GitHub icon
description: Replace 'ClaWDID' with 'ClawDID' across landing + SPA. Increase header logo size to match claweb.ai feel. Replace/complement 'Open-source' nav link with a GitHub icon button for a more professional header.
notes: Branding pass: 'ClawDID' everywhere (was 'ClaWDID') across site, SPA, docs, backend README/metadata. Landing header logo enlarged; nav now uses GitHub icon link with accessible label. Updated site smoke test to expect new header + GitHub link. Playwright screenshots (local): artifacts/ux-2026-02-22/site-home-review2-*.png.

title: Docs: add ROADMAP.md for clawdid
description: Add a clear, OSS-friendly roadmap covering: transparency mechanism, witnesses/gossip, rate limiting + abuse controls, ops hardening, and client integrations (aweb/aw/claweb).

title: UX: Playwright review of SPA + marketing site
description: Run Playwright against local SPA (18113) + Hugo site (18114), capture screenshots, and write a UX review doc with prioritized follow-ups + beads for fixes.
notes: Wrote docs/ux-review-2026-02-22.md and captured screenshots in artifacts/ux-2026-02-22/. Filed follow-ups: clawdid-l2q, clawdid-638, clawdid-ld2, clawdid-3xe, clawdid-yfa.

title: API: version ClaWDID endpoints
description: Decide whether ClaWDID API should be  (aweb-style) or bare  (per addendum examples). Current backend uses bare  but also has . Align and update docs + clients.

title: Site: docs page should render or link protocol docs
description: /docs/ lists sot.md and other docs as code, but they aren't clickable/readable. Render markdown into Hugo (preferred) or link to GitHub as a stopgap. See docs/ux-review-2026-02-22.md.
notes: Updated site docs page to include clickable links to protocol docs + roadmap on GitHub.

title: UX: use res logo in SPA + marketing site
description: Wire the new ClaWDID logo from res/ into the SPA header and the Hugo marketing site header/hero, ensuring professional sizing/spacing and accessible alt text.
notes: Integrated new logo from res/ into SPA header + marketing site header; added favicon/apple-touch in SPA and PNG icon + OG/apple-touch in Hugo base template. Playwright screenshots (local, ignored by git): artifacts/ux-2026-02-22/spa-home-*.png, site-home-*.png, site-docs-mobile.png.

title: SPA: friendly error UX + client-side stable-id validation
description: Current error states show raw HTTP status + JSON. Parse {detail} and add client-side validation for did:claw:/did:aw prefixes before requesting. See docs/ux-review-2026-02-22.md.
notes: Improved error UX: client-side stable-id prefix validation; fetchJson now extracts {detail} from JSON errors; Enter-to-submit on inputs.

title: Docs: restructure ClawDID protocol docs into Hugo pages
description: Split sot.md and addendum into focused, standalone Hugo docs pages. Seven content pages plus landing page with navigation.
close_reason: 7 Hugo doc pages created, sidebar nav, smoke tests pass

title: [MVP] ClaWDID service + spec hardening
description: [MVP] Delivered OSS ClaWDID mapping/audit service scaffold aligned with claweb structure: `backend/` FastAPI + pgdbm/Postgres + migrations, Dockerfile.release + render.yaml + ops endpoints. Specs hardened in `sot.md` and `sot-2026-02-22-addendum-v2.md` (message_id, derivation bytes, audit log hash-chain, /full auth). Follow-ups tracked in clawdid-82y (CI/CD), clawdid-rw1 (Render deploy), clawdid-pi8 (rate limiting), clawdid-zqn (doc URL alignment).

title: CI/CD: build + push GHCR image
description: Add GitHub Actions workflow to build Docker image from `Dockerfile.release` and push to `ghcr.io/beadhub/clawdid` on git tag. Include build identity env vars (CLAWDID_GIT_SHA/CLAWDID_RELEASE_TAG/CLAWDID_BUILT_AT) like claweb.

title: Docs: aw algorithm to verify /did/{did_claw}/key log_head
description: Draft a standalone doc with normative client-side verification algorithm for ClaWDID GET /did/{did_claw}/key including log_head validation (signature + entry_hash + consistency checks), cache rules, and failure modes; share with rose (aw).

title: Spec: normalize server URL + stable-id encoding
description: Tighten spec to avoid state_hash mismatches: define canonical server_url form (origin-only, no trailing slash, lowercase host, etc.) and decide whether stable_id suffix is raw base58btc or multibase (recommended: 'z' prefix). Update SOT/addendum accordingly and reflect in implementation.
notes: Spec+impl tightened: server_url must be canonical origin form (no trailing slash/path, lowercase host, default port elided). Enforced in backend register/update/full. Documented in sot-2026-02-22-addendum-v2.md; clarified did:claw suffix is raw base58btc (no multibase prefix).

title: API: add GET /did/{did}/head for efficient updates
description: Updates currently require fetching the entire per-DID log to learn (seq, entry_hash). Add a small head endpoint returning current_did_key, latest seq, latest entry_hash, and state_hash (and maybe updated_at) so clients can rotate/update without downloading full history.
notes: Implemented GET /did/{did_claw}/head (+ /v1) returning current_did_key and latest seq/entry_hash/state_hash/timestamp + updated_at for efficient polling.

title: Protocol: rotation announcement chaining for multiple rotations
description: Extend SOT §5.4 to handle multiple key rotations before a peer sees the first. Specify rotation_announcement(s) format, canonical payload, verification steps, and include conformance vector.

title: Protocol: define exact ClaWDID signature payloads
description: Tighten spec + backend so ClaWDID log entries are self-verifying: signatures must cover (did_claw, seq, operation, previous_did_key, new_did_key, prev_entry_hash, state_hash, timestamp) and any mutable state fields (server_url, address, handle) either directly or via state_hash. Current backend stores signature over action payload not including seq/prev_entry_hash; fix and publish test vectors.

title: Frontend: SPA for lookup + log verification
description: Add  (Vite+React+TS) SPA for did:claw lookup, log-head verification, full log verification, and did:key→did:claw derivation. Non-standard port; root Makefile targets for dev/build.

title: SPA: responsive nav (hamburger) + active tab
description: Mobile viewport nav is cramped; add responsive collapse + aria-current for active route. See docs/ux-review-2026-02-22.md.
notes: Implemented responsive mobile nav with Menu toggle + active route styling using react-router NavLink. Screenshots: artifacts/ux-2026-02-22/spa-lookup-mobile-after-nav.png and artifacts/ux-2026-02-22/spa-lookup-mobile-menu-open.png.

title: SPA: add form labels + copy-to-clipboard for DIDs/keys
description: Inputs currently rely on placeholder labels; add explicit labels for accessibility. Add copy-to-clipboard + truncation/expand for long values. See docs/ux-review-2026-02-22.md.
notes: Added visible form labels for stable ID and did:key inputs. Added copy-to-clipboard + truncated display for did_claw/current_did_key and derived stable IDs via new components (frontend/src/components/CopyButton.tsx, frontend/src/components/CopyableValue.tsx).

title: Dev: mirror aweb-cloud Makefile structure with collision-proof ports
description: Replicate the Makefile conventions from ../aweb-cloud for running services locally, but choose completely non-standard default ports so clawdid never collides with ../aweb-cloud, ../aweb, ../claweb, ../beadhub, ../beadhub-cloud. Keep ports overrideable via env vars.

title: API hardening: rate limiting strategy
description: Decide and implement rate limiting for public `GET /did/{did_claw}/key` and `GET /did/{did_claw}/log`. Prefer Cloudflare/WAF rules if available; otherwise add optional Redis-backed limiter similar to claweb.
notes: Implemented configurable app-level rate limiting with safe defaults (disabled). Added fixed-window limiter with memory backend and optional Redis backend; wired to public endpoints (POST /did, GET /did/{did}/key|head|log|full and /v1 equivalents). Added env vars + prod example config and ops docs. Added unit tests for limiter.

title: Ops: deploy clawdid.ai on Render
description: Document + configure Render service (render.yaml already present): env vars, database provisioning, health checks, rollout/rollback procedure. Confirm hostname and TLS.

title: API: /did/{did}/key include verifiable log-head evidence
description: Update ClaWDID GET /did/{did_claw}/key (and /v1 variant) to return mapping plus verifiable evidence of latest log entry (seq, entry_hash, state_hash, authorized_by, signature, timestamp, operation). Keep response additive/backwards compatible and avoid leaking address/server/handle.

title: Protocol: publish canonical-json conformance vectors
description: SOT §4.2 requires published conformance vectors. Add deterministic test vectors for: (1) message signed payload canonical bytes + expected Ed25519 signature, incl. message_id and optional stable_id fields; (2) ClaWDID log entry payload canonical bytes + expected signature/entry_hash; (3) did:key -> stable_id derivation vector. These are needed for Python (aweb/clawdid) and Go (aw) interoperability.

title: Site: Hugo marketing site (clawdid.ai)
description: Add  Hugo marketing site like claweb: Makefile, basic pages, and optional Playwright smoke test. Use non-standard port; root Makefile target to run.

title: Site: add favicon + CTA to verifier SPA
description: Home page triggers favicon.ico 404. Add favicon + link tags. Add clear CTA (e.g. 'Try the verifier') that points to the SPA (prod likely a subdomain). See docs/ux-review-2026-02-22.md.
notes: Added favicon.ico + head link tags; added CTA buttons (Try verifier / Read docs) and roadmap link on home.

title: Docs: align SOT endpoint examples with aweb /v1
description: Update `sot.md` and addendum examples that still mention `/api/...` to match current `aweb` route prefixes (`/v1/...`) and note that hosted claweb mounts OSS under `/api`.
notes: Updated sot.md and addendum examples to use /v1/* routes (aweb-style) and added a note that deployments may mount behind /api (e.g. /api/v1/...).
